product_one_liner.value: Abacus.AI is an agentic AI platform for professionals and enterprises that combines frontier models, autonomous agents, and organizational memory to automate work.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as an agentic platform combining frontier models, autonomous agents, and organizational memory. Its stated mission is to automate work for professionals and enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists a Pro plan at $20 per month, so a pricing page exists.

eng_blog.notes: The blog describes Abacus.AI research papers at NeurIPS and has a technical post on LLM training whose authors include Siddartha Naidu, identified as the company's VP of Machine Learning and Research. Another NeurIPS post is by Samuel Dooley, identified as an Abacus.AI research scientist. The posts concern the team's technical research and model work, meeting the threshold for a technical/research blog.

public_docs.notes: The public help guide links to multiple product documentation articles, including prompting tips, FAQs, LLM configuration, and connector documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Abacus.AI careers page lists an open Research Scientist posting, a qualifying AI/ML research role.

model_provider.notes: The RouteLLM product page says it offers models through one API and identifies OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google alongside their GPT, Claude, and Gemini models.
